content: Claude CLI headless mode: claude -p 'prompt' or --print. --output-format text|json|stream-json. stream-json = NDJSON one event per line (real-time). To capture final result: --output-format text then read stdout. To get structured events: --output-format stream-json. --allowedTools / --disallowed-tools to control tool access. --input-format stream-json for bidirectional JSON. For spawn_agent use: claude -p 'task' --output-format stream-json --dangerously-skip-permissions to get streaming output; capture last result event. Can pass via stdin. Subprocess via tokio::process::Command::new('claude').arg('-p').arg(task).arg('--output-format').arg('stream-json'). MCP timeout: MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT env var (default ~28h). Calls auto-backgrounded after 2 min (v2.1.212+) unless in non-interactive mode.
